reason: The explicitly unsupported archived package has current direct streaming use, a bounded compatibility surface, lifecycle and worker-thread hardening opportunities, and no maintained successor that preserves its callable Writable contract.

upstream.deprecated: This package is no longer supported.

directUse.proof: Exact 1.0.10 declaration and a constructor call using binary encoding, a 1 MiB highWaterMark, write callbacks, drain, and finish as the publication boundary.
Direct ^1.0.10 declaration and executable download stream using mode 0755 and finish completion.
Exact 1.0.10 declaration and tarball pipe whose completion is observed through close; the 2026 repository push does not make the 2023 default-branch head current maintenance evidence.

alternatives.name: write-file-atomic
alternatives.assessment: Actively maintained and more durable, but accepts whole strings or buffers rather than a Writable stream and is not a drop-in replacement.

alternatives.name: @trenskow/atomic-write-stream
alternatives.assessment: Current ESM-only alternative with a different constructor and lifecycle surface and no effective automated test gate.

alternatives.name: @parcel/fs-write-stream-atomic
alternatives.assessment: Closest API fork and includes worker-thread identity, but last published in 2022 and embedded in the Parcel monorepo rather than maintained as a current standalone successor.

alternatives.name: node:fs
alternatives.assessment: createWriteStream is not atomic; writeFile is a whole-value convenience and does not preserve the streaming API.

acceptanceCriteria: Preserve callable and newable CommonJS use, Writable backpressure, callbacks, and open/finish/close ordering
Preserve documented string paths, encoding, mode, flags, highWaterMark, chown, adjacent temporary files, and complete-winner concurrency
Characterize append flags as replacement semantics rather than silently presenting target append behavior
Preserve the Windows rename EPERM same-content comparison while rejecting different-content failures
Clean temporary files on explicit destroy and destination errors; document that callers must use pipeline or destroy for source errors
Prevent worker-thread and process-local temporary-name collisions with exclusive creation
Pass differential 1.0.10, CJS, ESM, TypeScript 3.9/current, scoped and historical-key packed consumers
Pass Node 14.15.1 through current Node, Windows/macOS filesystem CI, coverage, package-quality, license, and audit gates
